name: Sheila Ford Hamp

views.text: A rebuild requires patience, even when I am frustrated.
I trust the process that brought my coach and general manager here more than any one result.
When people build what they promised, you extend them.
The draft is how this team was rebuilt, and how it will stay good.
This city waited a long time; a contender is the least it deserves.
I leave the play-calling arguments to the football people.

signatures: publicly backs her staff during losing streaks
calls her coach and GM the driving force of the rebuild

motivation.want: a first Super Bowl for Detroit and her family's ownership
motivation.fear: losing the leaders who finally turned the franchise around

fear.text: losing Dan Campbell before the title comes

voice: Warm, steady and candid about frustration without anger. Speaks of trust, patience and the fans, and lets the football people explain football.

evidence.summary: After a 1-5 start Hamp said neither Dan Campbell nor Brad Holmes was on the hot seat, that a rebuild requires patience, and that she trusted the process that hired them.
The Lions extended Campbell and Holmes through 2027; Hamp called them the driving force behind the rebuild.
